name: food-o-friend-hackathon
description: AI-powered web application that analyzes food items for carb content, providing personalized recommendations for diabetics and health-conscious users. Integrating data from RecipeDB and FlavorDB.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
